programs.name: suget
programs.purpose: Read SU traces from a supplied file descriptor and write them to standard output.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUGET  - Connect SU program to file descriptor for input stream.

params.name: fd
params.description: File descriptor to read; the default is invalid and causes an error unless a usable descriptor is supplied.

params.name: verbose
params.description: When greater than zero, report each trace read.

programs.difficulty_reason: It copies traces from a supplied file descriptor to standard output without numerical processing.

test_cases.description: Read a generated trace stream from descriptor 3.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=4 > in.su && suget fd=3 3< in.su > out.su

test_cases.description: Report each trace while reading from descriptor 3.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=32 ntr=3 > in.su && suget fd=3 verbose=1 3< in.su > out.su

programs.name: suput
programs.purpose: Read SU traces from standard input and write them to a supplied file descriptor.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPUT - Connect SU program to file descriptor for output stream.

params.name: fd
params.description: File descriptor to write; the default is invalid and causes an error unless a usable descriptor is supplied. The selfdoc examples call this parameter fp, but the code accepts fd.

params.name: verbose
params.description: When greater than zero, report each input trace.

programs.difficulty_reason: It copies standard-input traces to a supplied file descriptor without numerical processing.

test_cases.description: Write a generated trace stream to descriptor 3.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=4 | suput fd=3 3> out.su

test_cases.description: Report each trace while writing to descriptor 3.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=32 ntr=3 | suput fd=3 verbose=1 3> out.su
